# Web Gallery of Art

> > Comprehensive searchable database of European fine arts from 200-1900, featuring paintings, sculptures, and illuminations with detailed artist biographies.

The Web Gallery of Art is a virtual museum and searchable database covering European art history from the Early Christian period through the 19th century. It provides high-quality digital reproductions, comprehensive artist biographies, and scholarly information on major works from Renaissance masters like Leonardo da Vinci, Botticelli, and Raphael to Baroque and later periods, with particular strength in Italian, Dutch, and Flemish art.

## Key Topics

- Renaissance art
- Italian Renaissance

## Getting Started

- [Web Gallery of Art, searchable fine arts image database](https://www.wga.hu): Homepage for searchable European art database (200-1900) with biographies

## Renaissance Masters

- [Biography](https://www.wga.hu/bio/b/botticel/biograph.html): Sandro Botticelli: Florentine Renaissance master with Medici patronage
- [Biography of AMADEO, Giovanni Antonio in the Web Gallery of Art](https://www.wga.hu/bio/a/amadeo/biograph.html): Giovanni Antonio Amadeo: Lombard Renaissance architect & sculptor
- [Biography](https://www.wga.hu/bio/b/bramanti/biograph.html): Bramantino: Milanese Renaissance painter & architect at Sforza court
- [Biography](https://www.wga.hu/bio/b/barbari/biograph.html): Jacopo de' Barbari: Venetian Renaissance painter & copper engraver
- [Biography of CAPORALI, Bartolomeo in the Web Gallery of Art](https://www.wga.hu/bio/c/caporali/biograph.html): Bartolomeo Caporali: 15th-century Perugia Renaissance painter
- [Biography of AGRATE, Gian Francesco Ferrari d' in the Web Gallery of Art](https://www.wga.hu/bio/a/agrate/biograph.html): Gian Francesco Ferrari d'Agrate: Renaissance sculptor from Parma

## Baroque and Mannerist Artists

- [Biography](https://www.wga.hu/bio/b/bronzino/biograph.html): Agnolo Bronzino: Florentine Mannerist & Medici court portraitist
- [Biography](https://www.wga.hu/bio/b/baciccio/biograph.html): Baciccio (Gaulli): Baroque painter known for illusionistic ceiling frescoes
- [Biography](https://www.wga.hu/bio/c/cagnacci/biograph.html): Guido Cagnacci: 17th-century Emilian Baroque painter influenced by Reni
- [Biography](https://www.wga.hu/bio/c/calvaert/biograph.html): Denys Calvaert: Flemish Mannerist painter & Bologna art academy founder
- [Biography of BELLIS, Antonio de in the Web Gallery of Art](https://www.wga.hu/bio/b/bellis/biograph.html): Antonio de Bellis: Neapolitan Baroque painter (1616-1656)

## Dutch and Flemish Artists

- [Biography](https://www.wga.hu/bio/a/aelst/biograph.html): Willem van Aelst biography: Dutch still-life painter (1627-1683)
- [Biography](https://www.wga.hu/bio/b/bijlert/biograph.html): Jan van Bijlert: Utrecht Caravaggisti painter (1597-1671)

## Venetian and Vedute Painters

- [Biography](https://www.wga.hu/bio/c/canalett/biograph.html): Canaletto: Venetian vedute master known for topographical paintings

## Medieval and Early Artists

- [Biography](https://www.wga.hu/bio/a/agostino/biograph.html): Agostino di Giovanni: Sienese medieval sculptor (1310-1347)
- [Biography](https://www.wga.hu/bio/b/borras/biograph.html): Fray Nicolás Borrás: Spanish religious painter, Valencia school
